message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: The defendant copied pornographic video files from a computer and charged fees, i.e., distributing pornographic material for profit. Under Chinese criminal law, this is "传播淫秽物品罪" (Crime of distributing obscene materials). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the fact is about copying and charging fees, which is "传播淫秽物品牟利罪" (distributing obscene materials for profit). The specific article: Criminal Law article 363 (传播淫秽物品牟利). So the crime is "传播淫秽物品牟利罪". Also maybe "非法复制淫秽物品罪"? The law lumps copying and distributing under same. So only one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]传播淫秽物品牟利罪<eoa>
